title: Irish and Mexican grandfather, father's Spanish name, mother's Mohawk blood
summary: Durham says his grandfather Durham was Irish and married a Mexican woman, his father was called Jose with a waxed mustache, and his mother had Mohawk blood.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: think was very interesting -- I think we ought to go back to your dad because -- no, to your grandfather. You said that he was Irish --
: -- and he married a Mexican lady --
: -- and he lived in Mexico, I presume, did he? Are we speaking of your grandfather Durham?
I don't know. I don't know. He was living (unintelligible) where Hirshel (inaudible).
: Oh, I see, I see. This is your grandfather, now, not your father.
: Yeah. We were talking about that mixture and then your father -- did he speak Spanish as a native language?
His name in Spanish was Jose.
Yeah and he wore a waxed mustache all the time, always a waxed mustache.
Well, then you said your mother had Indian blood, Mohawk --
-- which you said the Mohawk territory is down in that area.
And you know, then you and I, we started --
The Mohawk is very dark Indians.
